item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod rgyud las srung ba mi 'jigs rdo rje'i gur khang
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma grogs kyi tshul du nas/ snyigs ma'i kho bo o rgyan bde chen gling pa rtsal la snyan du brgyud nas/ me sbrul hor zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer dgur 'bri rdza zab mo'i sgang du phab pas bstan pa dang sems can yongs la phan bde 'byung gyur cig/
